subject: Crosswalk: MAP POC sprint owners & environment setup (API keys, allowlist, peering)
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Jacobs <erin.jacobs@heliumhealth.com>, Sam Cho <sam.cho@heliumhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Crosswalk: MAP POC sprint owners & environment setup (API keys, allowlist, peering)

Hi Erin / Sam —

Thanks again for the productive discovery yesterday. As discussed, I pulled together a concise crosswalk that maps MAP milestones to owner-level actions so we can close the POC on a two-week sprint cadence. Attached is a one-sheet (MAP-crosswalk-v1.xlsx) that we can iterate on. High level asks we need to lock this week:

- Org & admin: confirm the Helium Health org admin who can approve API key creation and sign off on test tenants.
- API keys: request for an ephemeral staging API key for the POC (scope: read/generate tokens, no production access).
- IP allowlist: please provide the CIDR ranges that will be allowed from your side, and we'll share our egress ranges.
- VPC peering: confirm whether Helium Health wants the peering to be established between your VPC and Redwood Private (VPC peering) or if you prefer VPN tunnel for the first sprint.

Proposed near-term timeline (week 1): org admin + API key issuance + IP allowlist exchange. Week 2: peering and smoke tests + sample workload run. If that sounds good, can you confirm owners for org admin and networking and share the IP ranges and an ideal 2-hour window for peering next Tue/Wed?

Attachments: MAP-crosswalk-v1.xlsx (worksheet: sprint-owners), network-diagram stub.

Next step: once owners are confirmed we'll drop the mutual action plan into the shared Drive link and update the HubSpot deal.

Best,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Erin Jacobs <erin.jacobs@heliumhealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Cho <sam.cho@heliumhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 12:37:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Crosswalk: MAP POC sprint owners & environment setup (API keys, allowlist, peering)

Diego —

Thanks for the clear list and the workbook. Quick responses from our side:

- Org admin: I'll be the org admin approver for the POC (Erin Jacobs). I'll loop procurement on the approvals that require a PO/contract note.
- API keys: Sam (copied) is our infra engineer and will handle creation of service accounts on our side. We prefer Redwood to create the staging API key and send the credentials to a secure channel.
- IP allowlist: attached is our current outbound range CSV (helium-network-ranges.csv) — those are the ranges Sam will test from.
- Peering: prefer VPC peering for the lower latency in the POC; Sam will confirm whether he needs a maintenance window.

For the peering window, Sam proposes Tue 2026-10-13 02:00-04:00 UTC (which is Mon evening PT). That works for our SRE and gives time for fallbacks.

Can Marissa or Rishi confirm Redwood's egress ranges and whether you need a Helium Health IAM role for the peering setup?

Cheers,
Erin
Erin Jacobs
Director of Platform, Helium Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Jacobs <erin.jacobs@heliumhealth.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Cho <sam.cho@heliumhealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Oct 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Crosswalk: MAP POC sprint owners & environment setup (API keys, allowlist, peering)

Thanks Erin — great start. A few operational notes from RedwoodOps:

- Egress ranges: attaching our egress CIDR set (attachment-stub-network-diagram.png shows locations). Redwood's POC egress ranges for the hosted/dedicated test tenant are: 34.201.32.0/19, 52.23.64.0/18, 18.204.0.0/16. We will provide a signed network ACL summary to your SRE via the Drive link.
- API keys: Marissa will own the request for the staging API key on our side. Diego, please confirm required scopes; we'll create a time-limited key (14 days) and share via DocuSign/secure vault.
- IAM role: for VPC peering we request a single-role cross-account configuration. If Helium prefers, we can do a short-lived admin link to approve the peering from your console. Sam, please advise which you prefer.
- Attachments: I uploaded the MAP-crosswalk-v1.xlsx to the shared Drive and added a column for action owner and acceptance criteria.

Action items I own now: create staging API key template (Marissa), coordinate secure transfer, schedule a Redwood networking engineer for the scheduled peering window. Target to complete these by Mon 2026-10-12 EOD PT.

Marissa Cole
Engagement Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Erin Jacobs <erin.jacobs@heliumhealth.com>
Cc: Sam Cho <sam.cho@heliumhealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 08:54:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Crosswalk: MAP POC sprint owners & environment setup (API keys, allowlist, peering)

All —

Confirming scopes we need for the staging key: text-generation:write, text-generation:read, embeddings:read. No access to your production data stores. The staging key will be limited to a single test tenant and TTL 14 days.

Sam, regarding the IAM approach: we can support either (1) cross-account role with a short-lived assume-role flow, or (2) you create a dedicated peering IAM role and share the ARN. Option (1) is slightly faster for us to validate. If you can share the ARN or confirm option (1), the networking engineer will run the peering steps during Tue 2026-10-13 02:00-04:00 UTC.

I've also added a short smoke test checklist to the Drive (link above) — the critical checks are: establish peering, validate route propagation, test a 1k token generation at the 95th percentile latency, and verify logs flow to your audit bucket.

If Marissa can provision the key by 2026-10-12 EOD PT and Sam confirms the IAM path by EOD Mon (10/12), we should be green for the peering window.

Thanks — Diego

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Jacobs <erin.jacobs@heliumhealth.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sam Cho <sam.cho@heliumhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 16:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Crosswalk: MAP POC sprint owners & environment setup (API keys, allowlist, peering)

Quick note from security review —

- The requested egress ranges look good; I will run the internal review for the ACL exceptions and confirm by Mon 10/12 EOD PT.
- For API keys: please ensure the key exchange is done via the secure vault (no plaintext email). We will tag the key as "POC-staging-Helium-2026" and apply rate limits to match the smoke test.
- Logging: we need Helium to provide an S3 audit bucket ARN or syslog endpoint so we can validate audit delivery during the smoke test.

I'll follow up with a short checklist item in the MAP sheet. If all checks pass by Tue morning, we'll proceed with peering.

-Rishi
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
